findings.title: Competing M02 milestones — M02-foundry-preview vs M02-substrate

quotes: M02-substrate: `id: M02-substrate` `status: indexed-from-existing-phases` `purpose: Generated hierarchy index for existing phase/IP tree`

findings.why: Two directories occupy the M02 slot with overlapping scope (foundry runtime/control-plane vs ontology/identity/audit-chain/eventing). One claims status=complete while the other claims indexed-from-existing-phases with empty IP counts. Masterplan addressability is ambiguous; sequencing and dependency edges (M03 'gated on M02') cannot resolve to a single milestone.
findings.fix: Pick one canonical M02 layout. Either (a) merge M02-substrate phases (ontology/identity/audit-chain/eventing) UNDER M02-foundry-preview as additional phases, or (b) renumber M02-substrate to a distinct slot (e.g., M01.5 if it is M01 foundation work, or absorb into M01-foundation). Update masterplan.json edges and remove the orphan.

findings.title: Competing M03 milestones — M03-cloud-saas-search-workspace-preview vs M03-first-tenant

quotes: M03-first-tenant: `id: M03-first-tenant` phases P01-hr/P02-payroll/P03-accounting/P04-connect-pro-mail/P05-connect-pro-messenger — business-vertical scope unrelated to cloud preview

findings.why: Same M03 collision as M02. M03-first-tenant has business-app phases (HR/Payroll/Accounting/Mail/Messenger) that have no relationship to the cloud+saas+search+workspace preview scope. Two milestones at the same id slot break masterplan sequencing.
findings.fix: Renumber M03-first-tenant to a tenant-pilot slot AFTER M03 preview (e.g., M04-tenant-pilot or fold into M04-vertical-pilot-korea where Korean HR/Payroll/Accounting already belongs). Reserve M03 exclusively for the cloud preview.

findings.title: specs/cross-cutting NOT fully flat — lifecycle-configs/ subdirectory remains
findings.why: PR title is 'Flatten specs cross-cutting topology' and ADR-0119 is `specs-flat-root-topology` (+116 lines, ADDED). The flattening is partial: 9 lifecycle config JSON files remain nested in a subdirectory. Flat-root claim is contradicted by reality. If lifecycle-configs is an intentional exception, ADR-0119 must declare and justify it explicitly.
findings.fix: Either promote the 9 lifecycle configs to specs/cross-cutting/ with `-lifecycle.json` suffix (truly flat) or amend ADR-0119 to declare lifecycle-configs/ as the single sanctioned exception and add a CI lane preventing future subdir creation.

findings.title: Milestone hierarchy depth conformance not verifiable from PR — but no 4-deep violation introduced
findings.why: Per [[feedback_milestone_phase_hierarchy]] the rule is strict 3-level Milestone > Phase > ImplementationPlan. PR-18 touches the IP-001..IP-006 files inside M02-foundry-preview/phases/P02-*/ which IS the canonical 3-level layout. However, M02-substrate and M03-first-tenant claim 0 IP counts in their generated INDEX.md tables, meaning Milestone>Phase>(empty) — degenerate hierarchy. Generating skeleton indexes to 'close the master-plan hierarchy gap' is not the same as having ImplementationPlan content; it is hierarchy laundering.
findings.fix: Either populate the indexed-from-existing-phases milestones with real IPs or remove them and absorb scope into legitimate milestones (see C1/C2 fixes).

findings.title: M02 'wave' naming inconsistency
findings.why: Front-matter shape drift between sibling milestones at the same numeric slot.
findings.fix: Standardize front-matter fields across all MilestoneIndex docs (doc_class lint).

missing: No CI lane enforcing one milestone per numeric slot (M01..MNN must be unique)
No migration note in ADR-0119 about why lifecycle-configs/ remains nested
No deletion/redirect record for the pre-flatten specs/cross-cutting layout

perspectives.executor: Cannot deterministically resolve 'which M02' when masterplan.json says 'depends on M02'. Blocks autonomous execution.
perspectives.skeptic: Generated indexes claiming 0 IPs are a workaround to make masterplan.json validate, not real planning. Hierarchy gap is being closed cosmetically.
perspectives.stakeholder: PR title overpromises ('flatten') vs reality (one subdir untouched, plus two milestone duplications that the flatten doesn't address).

realist_check: C1 and C2 stay CRITICAL — masterplan sequencing edges are unresolvable when two dirs share the same milestone id; this blocks all downstream automation that walks masterplan.json. M1 stays MAJOR — flat-root claim is publicly contradicted in repo; ADR-0119 ships with provable factual gap.
